reviewer.delegationStatement: The creator explicitly requested another more complex and attractive region without primitive buildings, and instructed Codex to increase the catalog, use more variety and make the scene coherent. This bounded visual curation executes that request; the creator has not personally reviewed these assets.

criteria.note: Inspected multiview RGB evidence supports the concrete description; missing-roof and unrelated-style candidates were excluded. Decorative boundary section; no assembly-kit, mating-socket or navigation guarantee.

Exact retained GLB and measured material resources render successfully; source and rendered-view bytes are hash-checked. Decorative boundary section; no assembly-kit, mating-socket or navigation guarantee.

Measured Y-up bottom contact supports upright ground placement; terrain pads must cover the complete footprint. No sockets or enterable interior are asserted. Decorative boundary section; no assembly-kit, mating-socket or navigation guarantee.
